//! Configuration templates for various deployment scenarios

/// Configuration template generator
pub struct ConfigTemplate;

impl ConfigTemplate {
    /// Generate a basic service template
    pub fn service_template() -> String {
        let env_config = songbird_config::config::environment::EnvironmentConfig::default();
        format!(
            "[orchestrator]
bind_address = "{}"
port = {}
log_level = "info"

"
            [network]
enable_tls = false
enable_http2 = true

\
            [security]
enable_auth = false
enable_audit = false

\
            [observability]
enable_dashboard = true
metrics_interval_secs = 30
","
            env_config.bind_address, env_config.bind_port
        )
    }

    /// Generate a development configuration
    pub fn development_config_template() -> String {
        let env_config = songbird_config::config::environment::EnvironmentConfig::default();
        format!(
            "[orchestrator]
bind_address = "{}"
port = {}
log_level = "debug"
enable_metrics = true

"
            [network]
enable_tls = false
enable_http2 = true

\
            [security]
enable_auth = false
enable_audit = false

\
            [observability]
enable_dashboard = true
metrics_interval_secs = 10
","
            env_config.bind_address, env_config.bind_port
        )
    }

    /// Generate a production configuration
    pub fn production_config_template() -> String {
        let env_config = songbird_config::config::environment::EnvironmentConfig::default();
        format!(
            "[orchestrator]
bind_address = "{}"
port = {}
log_level = "warn"
enable_metrics = true

"
            [network]
enable_tls = true
enable_http2 = true

\
            [security]
enable_auth = true
enable_audit = true

\
            [observability]
enable_dashboard = false
metrics_interval_secs = 60
","
            env_config.bind_address, env_config.bind_port
        )
    }

    /// Generate a home network configuration
    pub fn home_network_config_template() -> String {
        let env_config = songbird_config::config::environment::EnvironmentConfig::default();
        format!(
            "[orchestrator]
bind_address = "{}"
port = {}
log_level = "info"

"
            [network]
enable_discovery = true
enable_tls = false

\
            [security]
enable_basic_security = true

\
            [discovery]
enable_multicast = true
discovery_interval_secs = 30
","
            env_config.bind_address, env_config.bind_port
        )
    }

    /// Generate a simple Dockerfile template
    pub fn dockerfile_template() -> String {
        let env_config = songbird_config::config::environment::EnvironmentConfig::default();
        format!(
            "FROM rust:1.75-slim as builder

"
            RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y pkg-config libssl-dev

\
            WORKDIR /app

\
            COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release

\
            FROM debian:bookworm-slim

\
            RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl

\
            COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/songbird /usr/local/bin/songbird

\
            EXPOSE {}

\
            CMD ["songbird", "start"]
","
            env_config.bind_port
        )
    }
}
pub mod production_analytics;

pub mod production_storage;
pub mod production_registry;
